_comment: Printed-arithmetic computed fields consumed by maine_forms_engine.computations. Every formula_text is the instruction printed verbatim on the blank (tests/test_computations.py re-checks this against the fetched PDF). Warnings-only: a supplied value is always written as-is.

facts.total_gross_estate.formula_text: Total gross estate. Add items 1 through 10

facts.alternate_value_total_gross_estate.formula_text: Total gross estate. Add items 1 through 10
facts.alternate_value_total_gross_estate.note: alternate value column of Part 5, same printed instruction

facts.total_gross_estate_less_exclusion.formula_text: Total gross estate less exclusion. Subtract item 12 from item 11.

facts.alternate_value_total_gross_estate.formula_text: Total gross estate less exclusion. Subtract item 12 from item 11.
facts.alternate_value_total_gross_estate.note: alternate value column of Part 5, same printed instruction

facts.tentative_total_allowable_deductio.formula_text: Tentative total allowable deductions. Add items 18 through 23.

facts.tentative_taxable_estate.formula_text: Tentative taxable estate. Subtract line 2 from line 1
facts.tentative_taxable_estate.note: line 1 is printed 'Total gross estate less exclusion from Part V, item 13' and is mapped facts.total_gross_estate_less_exclusion; line 2 is printed 'Tentative total allowable deductions from Part V, item 24' and is mapped facts.tentative_total_allowable_deductions

facts.taxable_estate.formula_text: Taxable estate. Subtract line 3b from line 3a

facts.gross_estate_tax.formula_text: Gross estate tax. Subtract line 7 from line 6

facts.allowable_applicable_credit_amount.formula_text: Allowable applicable credit amount. Subtract line 10 from line 9e

facts.tax_due_or_refund.formula_text: Subtract line 11 from line 8. If zero or less, enter -0-
facts.tax_due_or_refund.note: Part 2 line 12; the floor is the printed clamp

facts.net_estate_tax.formula_text: Net estate tax. Subtract line 17 from line 12

facts.total_transfer_taxes.formula_text: Total transfer taxes. Add lines 18 and 19
